title: A delivery is application/x-www-form-urlencoded with payload=<JSON>, and carries X-Signature: signature=<hex>,algorithm=HMAC-SHA256

source.note: Three documented facts, all asserted: the delivery is a POST of application/x-www-form-urlencoded whose required field is `payload`, "a JSON-encoded object with entity details", with domain_prefix and environment optional beside it; the header format is exactly "X-Signature: signature=897hRT893qkA783M093ha903f,algorithm=HMAC-SHA256", comma-separated key=value pairs in one header value. What the page does NOT settle is what is hashed -- "generate a signature by hashing the webhook request body" over a form body with JSON inside a field has two readings -- nor the encoding, since its sample value is neither hex nor base64. This unit signs the raw form bytes and encodes hex; both are JUDGMENT and both are published at GET /__unit/info under signer.payload_provenance and signer.encoding_provenance, which this case reads rather than asserting a signature value.

steps.name: the unit publishes the documented header and format
the delivery is form-encoded and signed in the documented shape
